anti_toolbox_hits.justification: Lowe's header is the search + store-selector router (IA priorities search-led-ia and audience-routing); keeping the main bar reachable while browsing 13 sections of inventory is the brand's IA, not a decorative reflex. Only the main bar sticks; utility bar and department row scroll away.

brand_faithful_inversions: pure-white retention — `#ffffff` retained as page ground (existing Lowe's decision; captured --background-color #fff). The 'no pure black/white' rule is inverted per brand-faithful direction.
hex format retention — color tokens retained in hex (matches captured brand surface and DESIGN.md Stitch frontmatter). OKLCH applies to new authoring; this is inheritance.
saturated color retention — saturated `#0072ce` and `#007a33` retained as Lowe's interactive and action voices. The tinted-neutral reflex is inverted per brand-faithful direction.

narrative.northStar: Lowe's homepage as a well-run aisle: every offer in live Fellix type, every department visible at a glance, the search and the store always one reach away.
narrative.overview: White ground, navy chrome, blue for wayfinding, green only for the cart. Fellix 400/600 only. 8px corners, 20px pills. Grids over rails.
keyCharacteristics: Header router: search + store + Pro/credit + cart
Navy footer band built from captured nav
rules: Promotional copy is never baked into images.
A rail must justify itself; default is a visible grid.
Sponsored inventory is always labelled and never leads the page.
Numbers on the page come from the capture or render as placeholders.
dos: Reuse captured images at the same semantic position
Keep Add to Cart on every product card
donts: Invent stats, testimonials or store data
Introduce colors or fonts outside the captured surface
